bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Champion/challenger compared the challenger against itself
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: train_model writes metrics.json as a side effect; retrain_task read the champion AUC from that same file after training, loading the challenger's own metrics. The gate was 'auc >= auc' — always true — so every challenger was promoted, including regressions. Champion is now read before training via read_champion_auc(); a rejected run restores the champion's metrics.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Ad-hoc FAISS index builds clobbered the serving index
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: build_faiss_index wrote to the shared FAISS_INDEX_PATH unconditionally, so any caller building a throwaway index replaced the deployed one. Tests building dim-8/dim-16 indexes left a mismatched index on disk and the similarity endpoint failed on an opaque FAISS assertion. Persistence is now opt-in; load_faiss_index rejects a dimension mismatch and rebuilds; search_similar_items raises a clear ValueError.

data_note: No proprietary dataset ships with the repo. make_purchase_labels generates signal-bearing labels from a logistic transform of a latent propensity score over real conversion drivers, with Gaussian noise keeping the problem non-separable. CV AUC 0.717 reflects genuine but imperfect signal; a bootstrap fit on random labels scored 0.524 as expected for noise.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: DropCategoricalColumns silently missed string columns
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: Selection was by `dtype == object`, but pandas reports string columns as the dedicated `str` dtype under the PyArrow-backed default, so non-numeric data would have reached StandardScaler. Caught by a failing test; now selects by 'not numeric dtype'.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Champion/challenger gate compared the challenger against itself
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: train_model writes metrics.json as a side effect, and the gate read the champion's R2 from that same file after training. The comparison was always true, so every challenger promoted including regressions. Champion is now read before training; a rejected run restores its metrics.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Ad-hoc similarity index builds clobbered the serving index
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: build() wrote to the shared FAISS_INDEX_PATH unconditionally. Persistence is now opt-in via build(..., persist=True).

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: n_features understated the feature space
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: Reported the raw input width (8) rather than the post-pipeline width the model actually sees (47). Both are now reported.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: model_metrics table was defined but never written to
bugs_found_and_fixed.detail: Training history was lost on every retrain. record_training_run now appends each run and the retraining DAG opts in; a persistence failure is logged without aborting training.

data_note: No proprietary seismic catalogue ships with the repo. make_synthetic_dataset generates events from a Richter-like relationship (log amplitudes, depth attenuation, fault seismicity, station count) with Gaussian noise keeping the problem non-separable. CV R2 0.822 reflects recovery of a known physical relationship, not accuracy on real catalogue data. This is stated plainly in the README.
